_source: Script v2 (design/script_v2.md d1; applied 5 Oct 2026), from Blueprint F2 (opening, frame by frame) and F3 (false assumption line). 'see' and 'animation' are art/animation direction, not on-screen text. 'prop' = handwritten text on an object in the frame (Caveat, the investigator's casebook hand).

frames.see: Rainy Veyra road. Typed case file and lantern held from off-screen.
frames.narration: The file was ten years old. The village was still listed as a disappearance.
frames.animation: Slow rain; comic panel slides in.

frames.see: Gloved hands with three brass cuff buttons set the lantern down. Cracked teal glass. The lantern case has a scratched patch where initials were. A handwritten note is pinned to the typed file. A silver glint shows in the coat pocket. The face is never shown.
frames.narration: The request was unsigned. I found it in my lantern case.
frames.prop: Veyra stopped at 2:17. Someone has to remember it.

frames.narration: Every clock in Veyra stopped at the same minute.
frames.animation: The hand twitches but never advances.

frames.see: Mira appears by the schoolhouse. The investigator stays off-frame.
frames.narration: She looked at me as though she had been waiting for ten years.
frames.animation: Mira fades in; the investigator remains off-frame.

frames.see: The Figure sprite in the window reflection.
frames.narration: I had never been to Veyra. The window seemed to disagree.
frames.animation: Reflection doubles for one beat, then clears.

frames.see: Village hub, three witnesses, clock tower and locked well.
frames.narration: The case began with a missing village. It would end by asking who had erased it.

falseAssumption: I came here to investigate a ten-year-old disappearance.
